name: Frost Lance
summary: A spear of ice that pierces a target and slows its movement.

stats.effect: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes 3d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.
stats.cantripUpgrade: The damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5, 11, and 17.
